memory_update.text: ALAB should be retained as the reference pure-play AI fabric plumbing anchor, but it is no longer an underfollowed small/mid-cap candidate given current large-cap status and high attention.
CRDO is one of the cleanest US-listed AEC and high-speed connectivity candidates for this node; despite current large-cap status, it remains relevant because exposure is unusually direct.

The US-listed pure-play small/mid-cap universe for AI fabric interconnect silicon appears thin; many direct assets are now large-cap or private, so later passes should search international listings and private suppliers for validation.

Key falsification tests for this node: hyperscalers insource retimers/AECs; optical alternatives displace copper faster than expected; customer concentration reverses; or AI fabric content per accelerator declines.

node: AI fabric interconnect silicon and board-level connectivity
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around AI fabric plumbing. The cleanest reference exposure is Astera Labs in PCIe/CXL retimers, smart cable modules, CXL memory controllers, and fabric switches. The underfollowed lane is less small-cap than desired because the purest public assets have already repriced into large-cap territory, but Credo, Semtech, and TTM Technologies still map to narrow interconnect, active-copper, signal-integrity, and advanced-PCB chokepoints one or two layers below GPUs and switches. No buy/sell view is implied; these are research candidates requiring later evidence checks on customer concentration, AI-data-center revenue materiality, margins, and competitive substitution.
